verdict.line: You lose if you auto-trade into a fresh Granite Shield or eat his Ground Slam into Seismic Shard combo; you win all-ins timed right after his Q's speed steal fades, backed by Counter Strike.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane (48.5% Jax win rate over 2255 games) decided by execution, not draft. Malphite's Granite Shield (Passive) and the attack-speed cut from Ground Slam (E) blunt your auto-reliant poke early, but once his shield is worn down and you've built into Trinity Force, nothing in his kit answers a well-timed Counter Strike (E) stun.

theirWindow.what: Ground Slam (E) cuts your attack speed on its 7s cooldown, and his follow-up Seismic Shard (Q) out-damages your Q-E combo according to the measured matchup read. Back off rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: After his Q speed steal fades
yourWindow.what: Once the movement bonus from Seismic Shard (Q) wears off he's no longer faster than you, so this is when Leap Strike (Q) actually sticks. Commit your all-in here, not while he's still running the buff.

start.why: 49.4% win rate over 1489 games and the majority pick (53.8%); the sustain and poke reduction directly offsets Malphite's early Seismic Shard chip damage.

boots.why: 49.3% win rate and the clear majority pick (66.1%) in this matchup; the tenacity matters once he lands Unstoppable Force (R) or Ground Slam's attack-speed cut.

core.why: Highest-pick core path (10.5%, 59.3% win rate) — the proc damage is what finally breaks through Granite Shield in extended trades.
Pairs with Trinity Force in the same path; its on-hit proc and shield reward you for landing Empowered autos into his recharging shield.
Shows up as the third item in every measured core path for this matchup; it covers you against his single-target Unstoppable Force engage once he hits 6.

situational.when: he's stacking armor off Brutal Strikes (W) and you need percent-health damage to shred through it
the lane turns into a long poke war and you need the sustain to outlast his Seismic Shard chip
you fall behind early and need the extra sustain and true-damage proc to survive extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: The highest-pick page for this matchup (24%, 49.1% win rate); the sustain and health scaling directly answer a poke-heavy opponent whose damage comes from sustained trades rather than burst.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is the top pairing in this matchup (47.6% win rate, 46.6% pick) and lets you reset waves in an even lane; Flash + Ignite (47.4%, 49.9% pick) is the alternative if you want kill pressure for an early all-in instead.

playing.title: Punish the Granite Shield gap
playing.detail: His Passive absorbs damage but recharges when he hasn't been hit recently. Chunk it down with autos before you commit your Q-E all-in, or your Counter Strike stun damage gets eaten by a full shield.

playing.title: Wait out his Q speed steal
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (Q) steals your movement speed on hit, briefly making him faster than you. Don't force Leap Strike (Q) to stick during that window — wait for it to expire.

playing.title: Never auto through Ground Slam
playing.detail: Ground Slam (E) reduces your attack speed on a 7s cooldown. If it lands on you, disengage rather than racing him — his E into Q combo is the measured answer to your Q-E combo.

playing.title: Buffer W before leaping in
playing.detail: Empower (W) cycles on 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown. Queue it right before Leap Strike (Q) so the bonus damage lands the instant you arrive, helping you burst through his shield.

playing.title: Open fights with E, not autos
playing.detail: Counter Strike (E) dodges incoming basic attacks, then stuns and damages surrounding enemies at the end of its duration. Going first with it denies his auto-trade entirely before you follow with Empowered hits.

playing.title: Track his R from level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (R) is on a 130/115/100/80/80s cooldown and dashes from 1000 range. Respect it near your tower, but it's a single-target engage tool, not a reason to play passive in lane.

playing.title: Rush your core, not caution
playing.detail: At 48.5% over 2255 games this lane is decided by execution, not a draft edge. Prioritize Trinity Force into Sundered Sky so you're winning extended trades by levels 9-13 instead of turtling all lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Malphite’s Ground Slam (E) reduces your attack speed. Even if you execute your Leap Strike [Q] - Counter Strike [E] combo, his Ground Slam (E) – Seismic Shard (Q) combo will deal more damage. Try to use Leap Strike [Q] when his speed buff from Seismic Shard (Q) ends.
